svg.title: Allele segregation at meiosis I and meiosis II
svg.desc: After meiosis I, homologous centromeres are separated but sister chromatids remain joined. Without a crossover the homologs carry AA and aa. With a crossover each carries A and a. Meiosis II separates sister centromeres, giving AAaa or AaAa ordered products. Mitosis follows.
svg.metadata: Original editable schematic after source slide 59. Source: genetics/LECT09/lect09b-tetrads_1_introduction.odp, source art in ordered_before_meiosis.svg, ordered_meiosis_ii.svg and ordered_mitosis.svg. Unmeasured. A is green, a is purple. Source and stage ledger: SOURCE_STATE.json. Reconstruction 2026-11-09.

g.text: A and a not yet separated
